scope: Surviving Victorian red-brick engine house and its connected one-storey boiler house at Western Springs, with hipped roofs, basalt quoins, tall round-headed windows, and large boiler-room arches.

originalReview.notes: Inspected the original title and imprint on PDF page 7 and the exterior plate on PDF page 167, printed page 123. The 1922 Auckland City Council volume is the publication witness. The plate identifies the engine house and lower wing with their historical massing. The distant perspective cannot establish fine window details. The current heritage inventory documents the two retained volumes and demolition of the octagonal stack in 1948.

quallaSearch.notes: Started with the published Qualla MOTAT gallery. Its cleared photographs depict the aviation hall, railway station, tramway or exhibits. The pumping station is represented by the independently dated 1922 municipal volume and the current written heritage records.
